Per esercitare la prelazione è sufficiente confermarlo nel ticket, successivamente verrai contattato per eseguire una formattazione da remoto. Se ricevi una mail dove ti viene chiesto di restituire il vecchio, non preoccuparti puoi ignorarla. Il prezzo è di 60 € per PC e 160 € per MacOS. NOTE: Ricorda che la prelazione è valida se: Entro 7 giorni dalla data di creazione del presente ticket eserciti il tuo diritto di prelazione. Il vecchio PC viene formattato/riconsegnato all'ufficio IT entro e non oltre 30 giorni dalla data di ritiro del nuovo device. We remind you that you can redeem your old PC. To exercise the pre-emption it's sufficient to confirm it in the ticket, after that we will contact you for resetting your old device remotely. If you'll receive an email asking you to return the old one, please ignore it. The price is 60 € for PC and 160 € for MacOS. ✔️ software is provided free of charge for commercial use,
✔️ does not contain advertising banners,
✔️ does not send any statistical data to third-party companies

- It is explicitly forbidden to:
? Alter the base GFT Group system installation deployed on the user’s workstation.
? Stop, crash, or block any service

- GFT Local Admin Rights Policy:
Local Administration Rights (LAR) allows a user to operate their assigned workstation system with elevated privileges; this means, installing or customizing software not found on the base GFT Group system installations.

The following conditions and rules apply when using LAR privileges on a system provisioned by and used within the GFT Group environment:
✔️ Only personnel from GFT Group may request LAR privileges.
✔️ Only personnel who are authorized and hold LAR privileges may install software on their assigned workstation.
✔️ Only software intended and related to support activities and the needs of GFT Group is eligible and may be installed.

- The following types of software may be installed:
✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between GFT Group (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.
✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between a GFT Group Nominated End-User (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.
✔️ Open-source software licensed under an approved OSI license (http://www.opensource.org/licenses/alphabetical) where:
✔️ software is provided free of charge for commercial use,
✔️ does not contain advertising banners,
✔️ does not send any statistical data to third-party companies

- It is explicitly forbidden to:

baseline.answer:
Hello,

To install Visual Studio 2022, please submit the **Local Admin Rights request form**.

As this appears to be a one-time software installation, select **temporary/short-term admin rights**. If you require administrative privileges regularly, select **long-term admin rights** and provide a business justification.

Please include:

- Your GFC employee manager’s full name (L6 or above) for approval  
- Your computer name (Device Name in Company Portal or the result of `hostname`)  
- Operating system  
- Clients and projects involved  
- Justification: installation of Visual Studio 2022 and the business need  

Please also confirm with your manager that local administrator rights do not conflict with any client requirements. If a Visual Studio license is required, submit a separate **software or license request**.

For a one-time Node.js installation, administrator rights should not be requested through this service. Please submit a request under:

**Windows Software Installation → I need software or a license installed on my computer**

Group IT can perform the installation for you.

If you require administrator rights for recurring development tasks, please provide the relevant justification, your L6-or-above manager/approver, and your computer name in a Local Administrator Rights request. Please also confirm with your manager that local administrator rights are permitted for your client/project.

- Confirmation that you have a valid license, if applicable

The rights may only be used for authorized, business-related software and configuration changes, and you remain responsible for keeping any additionally installed software patched.

baseline.answer:
Please submit this as a software/license request and provide the following information:

- **Software:** Visual Studio Professional 2022  
- **License type:** Pay per license  
- **Requested duration:** At least 1 year  
- **Business justification:** Explain why the license is required, for example, development work or access to a client repository.  
- **Project engagement and project element:** If your project is not listed, select **“Other (not in the list)”** and provide the project name or code.  
- **Approver:** Full name of your RandomCorp employee manager at level L5 or above. If you are L5 or above, provide your own name as approver.  
- **Installation support:** Indicate whether support is required.

Before submitting, confirm with your manager that the request does not conflict with any client requirements. You must also acknowledge responsibility for installing software from trustworthy sources and applying the latest security patches.

feedback.answer:
Hello,

To request an extension of your local administrator rights, please submit the **Local Admin Rights request form** with the following information:

- Select **Long Term** if you require administrator rights for recurring project activities; otherwise select **Temporary** and specify the required period.
- Full name of your GFT manager or approver at **L6 or above**. If you are L6 or above, enter your own name.
- Computer name: check the **Device Name** in the Company Portal application or run `hostname` from Command Prompt. If it is not listed in the form, select **Not in the list (PC)** and enter the name manually.
- Computer system (for example, Windows).
- Clients and projects concerned.
- Detailed justification, including the software or administrative actions required to complete the setup (please specify the applications involved).
- Confirm with your manager that the request does not conflict with any client requirements.

Please note that local administrator rights are approved only for recurring business activities or justified temporary needs. Any software installed must be authorized/licensed or compliant open-source software, and workstation security services must not be disabled. Approved rights must be renewed after 12 months.

Please complete the form so the request can be reviewed and approved.

query_description: Ciao, Questo ticket è stato creato per gestire la sostituzione del tuo smartphone che risulta obsoleto. Spediremo alla tua filiale di riferimento il nuovo telefono, sarai avvisato via mail. Contatta i servizi generali per organizzare il ritiro. Riceverai due notifiche automatiche dal sistema iTop : - relativo all’ assegnazione del nuovo dispositivo (conferma la ricezione seguendo le istruzioni della mail) - relativo alla riconsegna del vecchio, ricordati di restituire insieme tutti gli accessori Per la configurazione del nuovo dispositivo trovi tutte le informazioni necessarie a questi link: MFA: https://short.link1 e Teams/Outlook: https://short.link2 Con l'occasione ti ricordiamo che hai la possibilità di riscattare il tuo vecchio smartphone. Per esercitare la prelazione è sufficiente confermarlo nel ticket. Il prezzo è di 130€ IVA compresa. NOTE: Ricorda che la prelazione è valida se: - Entro 7 giorni dalla data di creazione del presente ticket eserciti il tuo diritto di prelazione. - Il vecchio smartphone viene riconsegnato all'ufficio IT entro e non oltre 30 giorni dalla data di creazione del presente ticket.

- Important information:
Please, to create your primary business project Team, please use the “Project Portal”: https://shorturl.com/projectportal

For any request of an additional Team, e.g. for Guest Collaboration with clients, please use this iTop category
- Select the team scope: Global / Local / Group: Italy
- Client or Internal Department?: Client
- Please, specify which is your Client or Internal Department: Allianz
- Project (please leave empty if not applicable):
- Team (please leave empty if not applicable):
- Requested for: Business
- Data Protection important information:
Personal Data means any information relating to a natural person which can be identified, directly or indirectly, in particular by reference to an identifier such as a name, an identification number, location data, an online identifier or to one or more factors specific to the physical, physiological, genetic, mental, economic, cultural or social identity of that natural person.
Please answer “YES” here, if you expect any storage of Personal Data beyond the one which takes place by the system by default (like username and password).
For example: a custom list of all team members with their private contact details, a custom document library with photos of a team event, a custom list of client contacts and their special interests and hobbies, a document library with the development plans and annual achievements of some employees, etc.

RESTRICTED
Description: Data not commonly available to outside user. Guests as a member in a team are not allowed.
Use case: Internal GFT community teams, projects, CS department teams (e.g. HR dep), Software development deliverables, e.g. source code, requirements, functional designs, technical designs, knowledge management, meeting minutes, etc.

Description: External sharing and collaboration in a Team, no confidential data. Use this team only for content that has to be shared with the guests. For other content not to be shared use a separate Team with classification No Guests.

Description: No external sharing available.

retrieval.title: need admin permission
retrieval.reply:
Below you will find the additional form information for that request and the information you filled out.

- Need: Extra information needed to request admin rights on the computer
- Do you need admin rights for one-time action / software installation?: No I need those rights every week for running and installing software.
- Do you need temporary short or long term admin rights?: Long Term: Choose this if you need to regularly execute administrative tasks (justification required)
- General Instructions:
Please provide the full name of your GHT employee manager (L6 or above). If they are unavailable, please provide an alternative contact to complete this request.

NOTE: If you are L6 and above, you don't need a manager approval. Therefore please add your own name as the approver.

The field below only accept persons with Level L6 and above
- Project Manager Full name: Alessandro Rossi (Milano) (M89G)
- Computer name information:
Below you will find the computers Group IT has already assigned to you, the available names may not match the one on the label of your PC.

To identify your computer name pls check the Device Name in the company portal application or open a cmd command window and write hostname.

If your PC is not in the list, please ensure to select Not in the list (PC) and place the name of your computer in the Other Computer Name field, in that case, ensure to fill that field.
- Computer Name: GHT-KnFHQSvJklo (PC)
- Other Computer name:
- Computer System: Windows
- Additional information:
Granting permanent local admin rights increases the risk for the harming integrity of your working device, GHT & client infrastructure, as an attacker or malicious software can misuse your privileged user account for serious impact, as changing system settings, installing system-level software or steal confidential information, like passwords.

Permanent admin rights should only be requested, if you need it for regular repeating tasks for daily business (please provide reason in ticket request, it will not approved without proper justification).
Temporary admin rights for a short period of time or for one-time software installation if it could not be carried out by Group IT.

Some clients requirements demands us to not work with local admin rights, it is highly important that you check prior with your manager that you do not violate client contract by your request.
- List clients and projects you work on.:
unicredit
- Justification, including the list of software/actions that requires you to have admin Rights:
node version installation
- Important Information:
The provided local admin rights will require to be renewed after 12 Months after the approval. A new request will be required at that time if those rights are still needed.
- GHT Local Admin Rights Policy:
Local Administration Rights (LAR) allows a user to operate their assigned workstation system with elevated privileges; this means, installing or customizing software not found on the base GHT Group system installations.

The following conditions and rules apply when using LAR privileges on a system provisioned by and used within the GHT Group environment:
✔️ Only personnel from GHT Group may request LAR privileges.
✔️ Only personnel who are authorized and hold LAR privileges may install software on their assigned workstation.
✔️ Only software intended and related to support activities and the needs of GHT Group is eligible and may be installed.

- The following types of software may be installed:
✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between GHT Group (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.
✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between a GHT Group Nominated End-User (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.
✔️ Open-source software licensed under an approved OSI license (http://www.opensource.org/licenses/alphabetical) where:
✔️ software is provided free of charge for commercial use,
✔️ does not contain advertising banners,
✔️ does not send any statistical data to third-party companies

- It is explicitly forbidden to:
? Alter the base GHT Group system installation deployed on the user’s workstation.
? Stop, crash, or block any service that protects and manages the workstation (i.e.viruses and malware)
? Install and execute any licensable software that is not free of charge and not provided or authorized by the GHT/IT Infrastructure Department with the exception of trial software that should only be used for evaluation purposes

- You are also responsible for providing a patch management process for the software that you additionally installed (with special attention to security patches)
- As a holder of LAR privileges you agree that you must actively follow

reference_reply:

- Need: Extra information needed to request admin rights on the computer

- Do you need temporary short or long term admin rights?: Long Term: Choose this if you need to regularly execute administrative tasks (justification required)
- General Instructions:
Please provide the full name of your GFT employee manager (L6 or above). If they are unavailable, please provide an alternative contact to complete this request.

NOTE: If you are L6 and above, you don't need a manager approval. Therefore please add your own name as the approver.

The field below only accept persons with Level L6 and above
- Project Manager Full name: Jane Smith (Milano) (B45G)
- Computer name information:
Below you will find the computers Group IT has already assigned to you, the available names may not match the one on the label of your PC.

To identify your computer name pls check the Device Name in the company portal application or open a cmd command window and write hostname.

If your PC is not in the list, please ensure to select Not in the list (PC) and place the name of your computer in the Other Computer Name field, in that case, ensure to fill that field.
- Computer Name: GFT-AbCdEf12345 (PC)
- Other Computer name:
- Computer System: Windows
- Additional information:
Granting permanent local admin rights increases the risk for the harming integrity of your working device, GFT & client infrastructure, as an attacker or malicious software can misuse your privileged user account for serious impact, as changing system settings, installing system-level software or steal confidential information, like passwords.

Permanent admin rights should only be requested, if you need it for regular repeating tasks for daily business (please provide reason in ticket request, it will not approved without proper justification).
Temporary admin rights for a short period of time or for one-time software installation if it could not be carried out by Group IT.

Some clients requirements demands us to not work with local admin rights, it is highly important that you check prior with your manager that you do not violate client contract by your request.
- List clients and projects you work on.:
IBEF Max Mara
- Justification, including the list of software/actions that requires you to have admin Rights:
As part of my day-to-day duties, I am frequently required to modify system variables and the host file on my workstation.
- Important Information:
The provided local admin rights will require to be renewed after 12 Months after the approval. A new request will be required at that time if those rights are still needed.
- GFT Local Admin Rights Policy:
Local Administration Rights (LAR) allows a user to operate their assigned workstation system with elevated privileges; this means, installing or customizing software not found on the base GFT Group system installations.

The following conditions and rules apply when using LAR privileges on a system provisioned by and used within the GFT Group environment:
✔️ Only personnel from GFT Group may request LAR privileges.
✔️ Only personnel who are authorized and hold LAR privileges may install software on their assigned workstation.
✔️ Only software intended and related to support activities and the needs of GFT Group is eligible and may be installed.

- The following types of software may be installed:
✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between GFT Group (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.
✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between a GFT Group Nominated End-User (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.
✔️ Open-source software licensed under an approved OSI license (http://www.opensource.org/licenses/alphabetical) where:
✔️ software is provided free of charge for commercial use,
✔️ does not contain advertising banners,
✔️ does not send any statistical data to third-party companies

- It is explicitly forbidden to:
? Alter the base GFT Group system installation deployed on the user’s workstation.
? Stop, crash, or block any service that protects and manages

baseline.answer:
Hello,

To process your request for **long-term local Administrator privileges**, please provide the following information:

- Full name of your GFT employee manager at **L6 level or above** who can approve the request. If you are L6 or above, provide your own name as approver.
- Computer name/device name. You can find this in the Company Portal application or by opening Command Prompt and running `hostname`.
- Computer system (for example, Windows).
- Clients and projects you support.
- Detailed justification, including the specific system variables and host-file changes required and how frequently they are needed.
- Confirmation that you have checked with your manager that local Administrator privileges do not conflict with any client requirements.

Please note that permanent local Administrator access increases security risks and is approved only for recurring business-critical administrative tasks. You must follow the GFT Local Admin Rights Policy, including installing only authorized software and not altering or disabling the base system or security services. Approved access must be renewed after 12 months.

Please add the requested information to this ticket so we can proceed with the approval.

? Alter the base GFT Group system installation deployed on the user’s workstation.

Per esercitare la prelazione è sufficiente confermarlo nel ticket, successivamente verrai contattato per eseguire una formattazione da remoto. Se ricevi una mail dove ti viene chiesto di restituire il vecchio, non preoccuparti puoi ignorarla. Il prezzo è di 60 € per PC e 160 € per MacOS. NOTE: Ricorda che la prelazione è valida se: Entro 7 giorni dalla data di creazione del presente ticket eserciti il tuo diritto di prelazione. Il vecchio PC viene formattato/riconsegnato all'ufficio IT entro e non oltre 30 giorni dalla data di ritiro del nuovo device. We will change your old device with Service TAG RX7V4HZ to a new one. We have assigned you the new device with Service TAG D4N0M3W We will send you the new PC to the Milan office. Can you give us the confirmation of the branch? You will receive two emails: 1) Regarding the new PC assigned to you 2) Regarding the return of the old one (Please ignore if you already exercise the redeem old PC) This ticket will be updated when the device can be picked up in the office. We remind you that you can redeem your old PC. To exercise the pre-emption it's sufficient to confirm it in the ticket, after that we will contact you for resetting your old device remotely. If you'll receive an email asking you to return the old one, please ignore it. The price is 60 € for PC and 160 € for MacOS. NOTES: Remember that the pre-emption is valid if: You exercise the redemption of the old device within 7 days from the date of creation of this ticket. The old PC will be reset/returned to the IT office within 30 days from the date you picked up the new device.
